title: BVAL brand deal check
description: Paste a creator handle and the brand's offer. BVAL reads the creator's real recent views, prices every term of the deal from cited 2026 benchmarks, gives a verdict, and drafts the counter-offer email. Only platform and handle are required.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: Where the sponsored post goes. Each platform is priced on its own metric: Instagram Reel plays, TikTok plays, YouTube views on videos 30+ days old.
platform.sectionDescription: Only these two fields are required. Everything below is optional and makes the price more accurate.

handle.title: Creator handle or profile link
handle.description: For example @creator or https://www.instagram.com/creator/. The account must be public. BVAL reads its last ~30 posts to get real median views.

niche.title: Content niche
niche.description: Brands pay more per view in some niches: finance 1.9x, tech 1.45x, lifestyle 1.0x, gaming 0.55x. Pick the closest.
niche.sectionDescription: Brands pay by niche and by where the audience lives, so these two change the price the most after views.

market.title: Audience's main country
market.description: Where most of the creator's audience lives (ISO country code). The same views are worth more to brands in some countries. Pick a suggestion or type any code (e.g. FR, JP, NG); unlisted countries use their regional rate. GLOBAL = US benchmarks.

offer.title: The brand's offer
offer.description: What the brand is paying. No offer yet? Tick the first box and BVAL tells you what to charge.
offer.sectionDescription: Add the offer to get a verdict (accept / counter / decline). No offer yet? Tick "No offer yet": BVAL prices the package you describe below and also suggests per-post rates, add-ons and three ready-made packages to pitch.

noOffer.title: No offer yet: suggest what I should charge
noOffer.description: Tick if the brand hasn't named a fee, or you're pitching first. The offer amount is ignored. You still get a price for whatever you fill in below (your own package), plus BVAL's recommended rate card: price per post, what each extra adds, and Starter / Standard / Premium packages.

brandName.title: Brand name
brandName.description: Used to address the counter-offer email.

amount.title: Offer amount (whole deal)
amount.description: The total fee the brand offered for everything below.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency of the offer. Converted at a dated exchange rate.

productOnly.title: Product only, no fee
productOnly.description: Tick if the brand offers only free product (gifted).

deliverables.title: What the brand wants you to post
deliverables.description: Add one row per content type. Leave empty for one main post (Reel, TikTok video or YouTube integration). 2 items get 10% off, 3+ get 15%.

type.title: Content type
type.description: Must match the platform chosen above.

qty.title: How many
qty.description: Number of pieces of this type.

rights.title: Rights the brand is asking for
rights.description: These clauses are where deals get underpriced. Each is priced as its own line. Leave at 0 if the brand didn't ask.
rights.sectionDescription: Usage, ads through your handle and exclusivity often add 50-200% to the base fee.

organicUsageDays.title: Brand can repost it on its own channels (days)
organicUsageDays.description: Reposting on the brand's Instagram/website/email. 0 = not asked.

paidUsageDays.title: Brand can run it as its own ads (days)
paidUsageDays.description: The brand uses your content in ads from its own account. 0 = not asked.

whitelistingDays.title: Ads through your handle: Partnership / Spark Ads (days)
whitelistingDays.description: The brand runs ads from your account (Meta Partnership Ads on Instagram, Spark Ads on TikTok). Not available on YouTube. 0 = not asked.

adSpendUsd.title: Planned ad spend behind those ads (USD)
adSpendUsd.description: Optional. If known, the ads fee is at least 3% of ad spend.

perpetualRights.title: Rights forever (perpetual)
perpetualRights.description: Tick if the contract asks to use the content forever.

exclusivityDays.title: You can't work with competitors for (days)
exclusivityDays.description: Up to 7 days around the post is normally free; longer is priced.

exclusivityScope.title: Exclusivity covers
exclusivityScope.description: Category = only competing brands; full = no other brands at all.

extras.title: Production extras
extras.description: Extra work or placements beyond the post itself. Leave defaults if not asked.
extras.sectionDescription: Fine-tune the quote and catch risky contract terms.

revisionRounds.title: Revision rounds requested
revisionRounds.description: One round is included; each extra round is priced.

crossPostPlatforms.title: Also post on other platforms (count)
crossPostPlatforms.description: Each extra platform for the same content adds 25%.

pinnedCommentLink.title: Pinned-comment link
pinnedCommentLink.description: YouTube only. A description link is always included.

contract.title: Contract terms
contract.description: Payment and legal terms BVAL checks for red flags.

paymentTermsDays.title: Paid how many days after delivery (Net days)

aiTrainingClause.title: AI training / likeness clause
aiTrainingClause.description: Tick if the brand may use your content or likeness to train AI.

outputCurrency.title: Show prices in
enumTitles: Local currency of the audience country
outputCurrency.description: Local currency works for the named countries (INR, GBP, EUR, BRL, IDR, MXN, CAD).
outputCurrency.sectionDescription: How you get the answer back.

generateEmail.title: Write the counter-offer email
generateEmail.description: A ready-to-send reply that uses only the computed numbers (+$0.20).

creatorName.title: Your name for the email sign-off
creatorName.description: Defaults to the profile's display name.

sendReportTo.title: Email me the result (optional)
sendReportTo.description: The email address of your Apify account. BVAL sends you the verdict, the price range, the counter-offer email ready to copy, and a link to the full report. Apify only delivers to your own account's address, so other addresses are skipped. The address is used only to send this email and is not saved in the results.

manualMetrics.title: Use my own numbers instead of scraping
manualMetrics.description: Fill this to skip scraping (cheaper, instant), e.g. to re-price the same creator with different terms.

medianViews.title: Median views per post
medianViews.description: Typical views of a recent post (Reel plays, TikTok plays or YouTube views).

engagementRate.title: Engagement rate (0-1)
engagementRate.description: Likes + comments divided by views, e.g. 0.035 for 3.5%.

medianShortsViews.title: Median YouTube Shorts views
medianShortsViews.description: Only for YouTube deals that include Shorts.

llmModel.title: Email AI model (optional)
llmModel.description: OpenRouter model ID used through Apify's OpenRouter proxy. Leave empty for the default.
